title: Silas and the Blue Hour
author: Sebastian Thackeray
blurb: Casper Almeida, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
